qualification.details: Who can apply: eligible officers of Major Port Authorities. The circular is addressed to the Chairpersons of all Major Port Authorities except KPL. Qualification and experience: as prescribed in the Recruitment Rules (RR), which are enclosed as Annexure-1. The Annexure-1 page in the text copy is not legible. Crucial date for eligibility: the last date of receipt of applications in November 2026. | Check the Recruitment Rules at Annexure-1 of the official notification for the full qualification and experience required for this post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways.
Take a printout of the online application and stick a self-attested passport-size photo on it.
Attach copies of your educational qualifications and experience, and an undertaking that you will not withdraw if selected (the Self Undertaking at Annexure-5).
Submit the printout through proper channel to your own Port Authority.
Your Port Authority forwards the application, with the documents listed below, so that it reaches the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, Rajaji Salai, Chennai - 600 001, by the last date.
Photocopies of your ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years. Each page must be attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Head of Department.
A certificate for any year or period for which an ACR / APAR is not available.
Your willingness to join the post if selected.
A No Objection Certificate from your Port Authority agreeing to relieve you.
Vigilance / Administrative Clearance in the proforma at Annexure-2, signed by the Chief Vigilance Officer.
Certification that your University Certificates are genuine and your degree is recognised.
If any major or minor penalty was imposed on you in the last 10 years, details of the disciplinary case with the supporting documents.
Complete service details, with every post held to date, in the format at Annexure-4.
The Certificate by the Head of the Office at Annexure-3.
Only applications received through proper channel will be considered. Applications that arrive after the last date, or without ACRs / APARs or other enclosures, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Can a fresh graduate or private-sector engineer apply?
faq.answer: No. Applications are invited only from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities, who join on absorption or deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale of the post?
faq.answer: Rs.50000-160000 (Revised). The pre-revised scales are Rs.20600-46500 / Rs.10750-16750.

faq.question: Q3. Is the online application enough on its own?
faq.answer: No. A printout of the online application must be sent through proper channel. Your Port Authority then forwards it to the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, Rajaji Salai, Chennai - 600 001.

faq.question: Q4. How many years of ACRs / APARs are needed?
faq.answer: The last 5 years. Each page must be attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Head of Department.

faq.question: Q5. On what date is eligibility judged?
faq.answer: On the last date of receipt of applications in November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Do I need to report past penalties?
faq.answer: Yes. If any major or minor penalty was imposed on you in the last 10 years, the details of the disciplinary case and the supporting documents must be sent.

faq.question: Q7. Which department is the post in?
faq.answer: The M & EE Department of Chennai Port Authority.

faq.question: Q8. Can I withdraw after being selected?
faq.answer: No. You must give a self undertaking (Annexure-5) that you will not withdraw your candidature if selected.
